rules.guidance: Don't ignore returned errors (`_ =` or unchecked); handle or wrap with context (`fmt.Errorf("...: %w", err)`).
`defer` Close/Unlock right after acquiring a resource so it's released on every return path; check the deferred Close error where it matters.
Plumb `context.Context` through I/O calls for cancellation/timeouts; don't store a Context in a struct.
Every goroutine has a clear exit (context/done channel); a goroutine blocked on a channel forever is a leak.
Be careful capturing the loop variable in a goroutine/closure (pre-1.22 semantics); capture a copy.
Shared mutable state across goroutines needs a mutex or channels; flag obvious unsynchronized access.
Writing to a nil map panics — initialize with `make` before writing.
